hypotheses.E1_exact_prediction_improves_fisher_recu: Within-exact-prediction Fisher-subspace overlap exceeds between-prediction overlap by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E2_exact_prediction_improves_logit_recur: Within-exact-prediction unweighted-logit overlap exceeds between-prediction overlap by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E3_exact_prediction_improves_input_recur: Within-exact-prediction input-sensitivity overlap exceeds between-prediction overlap by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E4_exact_prediction_stabilizes_token_lab: Within-exact-prediction matched-axis top-token Jaccard is at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E5_input_verbs_transfer_cross_corpus: Same-prediction input-subspace overlap across corpora is at least 0.10.
hypotheses.E6_input_recurrence_exceeds_random_subsp: Within-prediction input-subspace overlap is at least three times the 4/512 random-subspace expectation on both corpora.
